cs.t: > I'm not sure I ever met a CRT monitor over 19". Many years ago I delivered and set up 22" and, I think 24", Cornerstone and Sony branded monitors for banking, drafting, and medical use when I worked for VARs. They were beasts to lift but beautiful displays. I personally bought and used for many years a Mitsubishi Diamond CRT display with the NEC version of the Trinitron tube because it had multiple inputs (and I had all kinds of adapters) and would happily sync to nearly anything- Sun, Mac, SGI, pc, composite.
